Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah reached New Delhi on Sunday, beginning a two-day India visit whose central engagement is a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Monday.

The trip was arranged after a meeting in August helped ease a period of strained relations between the two neighbours. Aviation features on the agenda, with attention on whether Shah can secure from India what earlier Nepali governments could not on air routes.

India has separately dismissed reports that it sought Nepal's airspace for military flights.
